hypothesis.statement: COUNT PARITY IS REACHABLE AND THAT RECLASSIFIES THE FUNCTION. Two runs recorded the aRWork pair as 'proven inseparable' and read count-asymmetry as a permanent exclusion from every postprocessor class. It is not permanent: the joint form the BG record itself banked reaches T958/O958 - probe.py printed `COUNT-PARITY GAINED insns T958/O959 -> T958/O958`, the first time in this function's history. It was not KEPT because it costs real 131 -> 250 and fuzzy 98.1962% -> 97.0950%, but the class fact stands independently of the score. At parity the residual re-reads as `target-only: +3 mr / ours-only: -1 addi -1 lwz -1 stw`, and the aligned view names the exchange exactly: the target parks tplA1 (r1+440) in r14 (`@0x52c addi r14,r1,440`) and materialises the gifTag2 constant 0x60712435 in scratch r0 (`@0x4f8 addi r0,r6,9269` then `@0x500 stw r0,684(r1)`), while ours promotes that CONSTANT to a callee-saved register (`addi r17,r6,9269`) and spills tplA1 to slot 756. Six promotion candidates, and the two builds disagree about which one loses.
